scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @livething/server-cloudflare... --filter @livething/server-node... --filter @livething/client run build && LIVETHING_E2E_PREBUILT=1 pnpm run "/^e2e-lane:/"
scripts.e2e-lane:raw: pnpm --filter @livething/tests-e2e-server-cloudflare run test:e2e:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @livething/tests-e2e-server-node run test:e2e:node:http
scripts.e2e-lane:client: export LIVETHING_E2E_SERVER_PORT=8789 && pnpm run test:e2e:client-puppet && pnpm --filter @livething/tests-e2e-client run test:e2e:cloudflare && pnpm --filter @livething/tests-e2e-client run test:e2e:node:http
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter='!@livething/website' run typecheck
scripts.depcruise: depcruise server/src core/src client/src server-adapters/cloudflare/src server-adapters/node/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --parallel run clean && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf tests-e2e/node_modules && rm -rf .playwright-mcp
scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.check:ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm test && pnpm depcruise && pnpm bundle-check
